async def reconnect_circuit_breaker(self):
    async with self._lock:
        if self.state == CircuitState.HALF_OPEN:
            is_healthy = await self._probe_health()
            self.state = CircuitState.CLOSED if is_healthy else CircuitState.OPEN

viva_questions.question: Why did you use asyncio.Semaphore(15) alongside exponential backoff when flushing messages to DLQ?
viva_questions.mock_answer: I introduced the semaphore because under high throughput spikes, flushing 1000 failing payloads at once caused downstream Redis socket timeouts. Limiting to 15 concurrent dispatchers keeps memory predictable and respects downstream socket backpressure.
viva_questions.feedback: Exceptional production-grade systems understanding. Candidate reasoned through memory pressure and socket saturation.

viva_questions.question: How did you avoid race conditions when transitioning the circuit breaker state from HALF_OPEN to OPEN in a multithreaded worker pool?
viva_questions.mock_answer: I used an asyncio.Lock combined with an atomic status check before executing the probe call so only one coroutine conducts health checks while others wait in standby.
viva_questions.feedback: Strong concurrency foundations and distributed systems intuition.

viva_questions.question: In your pytest suite, how do you simulate network partition without killing the Redis test container?
viva_questions.mock_answer: I monkeypatched the redis.asyncio ConnectionPool.get_connection method to raise ConnectionResetError on every 3rd invocation, ensuring our retry policies were covered deterministically.

viva_questions.question: How do you verify the authenticity of incoming Stripe events to prevent signature spoofing?
expected_concepts: Raw body parsing vs JSON body
viva_questions.mock_answer: We use stripe.webhooks.constructEvent passing the raw request buffer and endpoint secret.

viva_questions.question: Why did you use typeof window !== 'undefined' check inside the initializer?
expected_concepts: Window object undefined on server runtime
viva_questions.mock_answer: To prevent crash during server rendering because local storage does not exist on server.

viva_questions.question: How do you avoid floating point roundoff errors when totaling currency amounts?

viva_questions.mock_answer: I multiplied by 100 and used Math.round.
viva_questions.feedback: Acceptable practical solution, though arbitrary precision decimal library is preferred in enterprise.
